description: utopia-php/circuit-breaker: circuit breakers judged on a rolling failure rate, half-open probes, state shared through Redis or a Swoole table, telemetry.

store.array.doc: fixture: the tests' array adapter, preloaded with `values` ([key, value] pairs; "$opened_ago_10" is time() - 10), logging every write

store.writes.doc: fixture: the writes an array adapter logged, as [op, key, value]

store.redis.doc: new Redis(redis client, prefix?) on the `redis` service

telemetry.new.doc: fixture: the Test telemetry backend, also logging every counter and gauge point

telemetry.log.doc: fixture: every logged point as [kind, name, value, attribute pairs]; gauge values (timestamps) as 0

telemetry.observe.doc: fixture: runs every observable gauge's callbacks: [[gauge, [[breaker name, value], ...]], ...]

breaker.new.doc: new CircuitBreaker(timeout?, successThreshold?, cache: store?, key?, telemetry?, metricPrefix?, window?, failureRatio?, minimumThroughput?, halfOpenPermittedCalls?)

breaker.discarded.doc: a breaker made like breaker.new and dropped at once: whether it is gone (nothing keeps it alive)

breaker.call.doc: $breaker->call(open: fn => fallback, close, halfOpen?) where close and half_open are {result} or {throw}, optionally running `during` actions inside first ({op: call|state|observe}): the result, or {result, during}

breaker.calls.doc: one call per `outcomes` entry (succeed or fail, fallback 'fallback', result 'ok'): count of each returned value

breaker.scenario.doc: a breaker made like breaker.new, then each of `steps` (succeed, fail, probe: with a half-open callback, trip): [result, state, failures, successes] after each

sleep.doc: fixture: waits `ms` milliseconds (open timeouts and windows are in whole seconds)

deviations.php: `open` is any callable and may throw; the call then reports the outcome `exception`, `short_circuit_exception` or `fallback_exception` and rethrows.
deviations.reason: The Rust fallback is an infallible closure returning the value: a fallback that fails is not representable (a caller wanting one returns a Result as the value).

deviations.php: The constructor reads the shared state from the cache adapter (and throws AdapterException when it fails).
deviations.reason: Constructors are not async in Rust; every operation reads the shared state first anyway, so only a failing store at construction time differs (the first operation reports it).

deviations.php: Any object is accepted and checked for get, set, incrBy and del methods (InvalidArgumentException otherwise).
deviations.reason: Redis<C> takes a redis-rs connection: a client without the commands does not type-check.

deviations.php: A Swoole\Table has a fixed number of rows: set() on a full table fails with AdapterException.
deviations.reason: SharedTable is a map in process memory that grows; Swoole's real capacity depends on its hash conflict allowance and is not a contract.
